verdict.rationale: An OS can reasonably ship built-in calendar, weather, maps, and clock apps, so this axis applies to Windows. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents any of those four apps. The only built-in apps evidenced are unrelated ones (Paint Cocreator, PC Health Check, Quick Assist, Game Bar, Live Captions), and the widgets mention is about news content, not these utilities.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can rely on built-in utilities like calendar, weather, maps, and clock apps out of the box
